build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with a ball, jar, and horizontal bar with a hole
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object with configurable scale and position in the PHYRE scene
add_static_bar: add a static bar object to the scene with configurable left or right alignment
update_task_relationship: update the task to require a ball to be inside a jar using SpatialRelationship.INSIDE
skip_template_params: skip invalid template parameter combinations by raising SkipTemplateParams when ball overlaps the hole
